lead: This week, the tech landscape sees significant developments in the Australian startup ecosystem, innovative product launches, and intriguing advancements in AI technology.

stories.title: Melbourne adtech Vudoo raises $22 million Series B as in-ad checkout takes on the US
stories.summary: Vudoo, an innovative adtech startup based in Melbourne, has successfully raised $22 million in a Series B funding round. The company aims to revolutionize the advertising space by integrating checkout capabilities directly into ads, targeting the lucrative US market. This funding will help Vudoo expand its technology and reach.

stories.title: Nvidia probes whether CEO Huang was target of foreign intelligence effort
stories.summary: Nvidia is investigating allegations that its CEO, Jensen Huang, was targeted by foreign intelligence. This scrutiny comes amidst rising tensions and concerns over the security of AI technologies. The outcome of this investigation could have significant implications for Nvidia's leadership and its operations.

stories.title: SpaceXAI Grok Bot availability just keeps growing - here's which plans offer it
stories.summary: SpaceXAI's Grok Bot is expanding its availability across various subscription plans. This AI tool is designed to assist users with multi-step tasks on cloud platforms, showcasing the growing trend of AI integration in everyday tasks. Users will need to navigate the different plans to find the best fit for their needs.

stories.title: Nvidia is investigating CEO Jensen Huang over affair with alleged Chinese spy
stories.summary: Nvidia's leadership is under scrutiny as CEO Jensen Huang faces an investigation related to an alleged affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. Huang has acknowledged the affair but intends to remain in his position. This situation raises concerns about corporate governance and international relations.

stories.title: Invest Rural puts investors on a bus after Bathurst brewer raises $513,000
stories.summary: Invest Rural is taking a unique approach to connect investors with regional startups by organizing bus tours. This initiative follows a successful fundraising event for a Bathurst-based brewer, raising $513,000. It aims to bridge the gap between urban investors and rural entrepreneurs, fostering growth in the regional tech ecosystem.

stories.title: Should you make the switch to Google Pixel from Samsung Galaxy?
stories.summary: As smartphone users weigh their options, a comparison between Google Pixel and Samsung Galaxy highlights the advantages of Pixel devices, including faster updates and less bloatware. This analysis comes at a time when consumers are increasingly looking for efficiency and simplicity in their mobile experience.

stories.title: Apps to distract you from the endless cycle of doomscrolling
stories.summary: In response to the pervasive issue of doomscrolling, several apps have emerged to help users engage with more productive content. These applications aim to provide a healthier digital experience, encouraging users to step away from negative news cycles and focus on enriching activities.

stories.title: What is the Slate Telematics Module and what can it be used for?
stories.summary: The Slate Telematics Module offers a customizable connectivity solution for Slate Trucks, allowing users to pay only for the technology they need. This minimalist approach to vehicle connectivity reflects a growing trend towards tailored tech solutions in the automotive industry.

stories.title: The one Starlink perk that gives it an edge over traditional internet
stories.summary: Starlink continues to differentiate itself from traditional internet providers by offering unique adaptability features. While cable and fiber may excel in performance, Starlink's flexibility in varied environments positions it as a compelling choice for users in remote areas.

stories.title: If Snap’s Specs are still ridiculously expensive, they’re also a lot more comfortable than they used to be
stories.summary: Snap's latest iteration of its Spectacles aims to enhance user comfort while maintaining a premium price point. This new version reflects ongoing efforts to improve wearable technology, potentially attracting more users to the augmented reality market despite the high cost.
